desc.NMS.rs.hide_mod_warning: Skips the "mods are installed" warning screen at game start. Mods still load. Takes effect at the next game start.
desc.SphereSizedMining.enabled: Raises the Terrain Manipulator's per-dig resource caps for the medium and large spheres. Off puts the vanilla caps back at once.
desc.SphereSizedMining.scaling: How the caps grow with sphere size: Volume (8 and 64 times for medium and large), Area (4 and 16), Linear (2 and 4), or Off for vanilla caps.
desc.SphereSizedMining.yield_mult: Multiplies the cap of the bigger spheres. The small sphere always keeps the vanilla cap, and no cap drops below vanilla.
desc.SphereSizedMining.max_factor: Upper limit on how many times the vanilla cap a dig may give.
desc.ToolModeBinds.enabled: Adds the tools switched on below to the Quick Menu's Change Secondary Weapon list. Picking one switches your main multi-tool mode; your secondary weapon stays as it is. Ctrl+digit binds them like any other row.
desc.ToolModeBinds.mining_laser: Adds a Mining Laser row to the weapon list.
desc.ToolModeBinds.boltcaster: Adds a Boltcaster row to the weapon list.
desc.ToolModeBinds.terrain_manipulator: Adds a Terrain Manipulator row to the weapon list.
desc.ToolModeBinds.more_modes: Other main multi-tool modes to add, by game name, separated by commas, for example Shotgun, Burst, Rail, Cannon. Untested; leave empty to add none.
ui.title: MODS
ui.no_edit: Text can only be typed in game: open this page from the Esc menu.
desc.*.status: Shows what the mod is doing right now.
desc.*.write_logs: Writes this mod's log file in its folder. Turn it on only when reporting a problem.
desc.HideEmptyHover.hide_empty_hover: Hides the Modify panel over an empty cargo slot. Clicking still opens Craft / Modify.
desc.HideEmptyHover.hide_tech_hover: Hides the Modify panel over an empty technology slot. Clicking still opens Craft / Modify.
desc.CraftFromStorage.anywhere: Cheat: craft from all ten Storage Containers wherever you are.
desc.CraftFromStorage.fossil_storage: The Fossil Assembly bone picker also lists the Storage Containers in reach. Back up your save first.
desc.CraftFromStorage.list_order: The All tab of item pickers lists inventories in order, Exosuit first. Off: the game's own order.
desc.CraftFromStorage.refiner_tab: Adds the Freighter and Storage tabs to the refiner's Transfer Items window.
desc.CraftFromStorage.log_feed: Only writes to the log. Turn it on, open a living frigate's Feed menu, and send the log to the author.
desc.CraftFromStorage.quick_rows: Quick Transfer lists every Storage Container in reach as its own row, with its name and free slots.
desc.CraftFromStorage.show_all_container: Keeps an All Containers row in Quick Transfer, with each named box listed under it.
desc.CraftFromStorage.cooker_tabs: The Nutrient Processor's Transfer window gets the same tabs as the other pickers.
desc.CraftFromStorage.cooker_elements: Hides elements such as Salt and Carbon from the Nutrient Processor's Processed tab.
desc.QuickRecharge.never_spend: Fuel names Charge menu: all will not spend, separated by commas. Click to type; Cancel keeps the list. Use the Clear row to empty it.
desc.QuickTransferAll.key: Hold this key while pressing Quick Transfer to send all matching items: Shift, Control or Alt.
desc.QuickRecharge.recharge_all: Clicking Recharge Equipment in the Quick Menu charges every listed technology, using your fuel.
desc.QuickRecharge.substances_first: Spend substances (Ammonia, Uranium) before crafted items (Ion Battery) when both can charge.
desc.QuickRecharge.play_sound: Plays the game's charge sound once per recharge-all.
desc.QuickRecharge.show_notice: Shows a notification listing what was used, for example Recharged 1 tech: 8 Pure Ferrite.
desc.QuickRecharge.free_fill: Fills every listed technology for nothing, like the free-charge game setting.
desc.QuickTransferAll.deposit: Adds a Quick Deposit button that moves each lit item into a container that already holds it.
desc.QuickTransferAll.same_item: Deposit only moves items a container already holds. Off: items no container holds move too.
desc.QuickTransferAll.suit_lock: Adds a lock button on the Exosuit page. In lock mode you pin slots so Quick Transfer, Deposit and sell skip them.
desc.QuickTransferAll.suit_lock_follow: A pin moves with its reserved stack when you move that item inside the Exosuit.
desc.SmallerInventorySlots.filters: Extra filter buttons on the inventory page, one for each item type.
desc.SmallerInventorySlots.remember_filt: The filter you picked stays when you change between inventory tabs.
desc.SmallerInventorySlots.remember_scro: Each inventory tab keeps its own scroll position.
desc.SmallerInventorySlots.remember_frei: The Freighter opens on the tab you used last.
desc.SmallerInventorySlots.sort_storage: Adds sort buttons between the two grids of a storage container.
desc.TradeUITweaks.shop_q_afford: In the shop, Q on the buy slider jumps to the most you can pay for.
desc.TradeUITweaks.shop_reset_list: Buy and Sell keep your place in the item list while the trade window is open.
desc.TradeUITweaks.shop_more_inv: Switch and the C key also cycle your vehicle, base Storage Containers and corvette parts.
desc.BiggerItemGrids.grid: Shows the grid size of the item cards, columns by rows.
desc.BiggerItemGrids.window: Shows how much larger the item window is than the game's own.
desc.BiggerItemGrids.patch: Shows whether the code patch for full-page scrolling is applied.
desc.SmallerInventorySlots.slots: Shows the slot size applied to the inventory grids.
desc.GalaxyMapFilters.probe: Developer probe for the galaxy map. Writes one log line for each system card you hover. Changes nothing in the game.
desc.GalaxyMapFilters.filter_gas_giant: Adds Gas Giants to the galaxy map Filter list. Systems with a gas giant light up in purple and every other star is dimmed. Gas giants only occur in purple star systems.
desc.GalaxyMapFilters.filter_abandoned: Adds Abandoned Systems to the galaxy map Filter list. Abandoned systems light up in cyan and every other star is dimmed. Most are purple stars, the rest green or blue.
desc.GalaxyMapFilters.filter_pirate: Adds Pirate Systems to the galaxy map Filter list. Pirate systems light up in red and every other star is dimmed. They are fairly rare.
desc.GalaxyMapFilters.filter_yellow: Adds Yellow Stars to the galaxy map Filter list. Yellow stars light up in yellow and every other star is dimmed.
desc.GalaxyMapFilters.filter_green: Adds Green Stars to the galaxy map Filter list. Green stars light up in green and every other star is dimmed.
desc.GalaxyMapFilters.filter_blue: Adds Blue Stars to the galaxy map Filter list. Blue stars light up in blue and every other star is dimmed.
desc.GalaxyMapFilters.filter_red: Adds Red Stars to the galaxy map Filter list. Red stars light up in red and every other star is dimmed.
desc.GalaxyMapFilters.filter_purple: Adds Purple Stars to the galaxy map Filter list. Purple stars light up in purple and every other star is dimmed. Every gas giant and every Dissonant system is a purple star.
desc.GalaxyMapFilters.debug_paint: Test switch. Stars that match the selected galaxy map filter turn solid green and every other star turns solid magenta. Turn it off for normal use.
desc.PickerTweaks.picker_search: With a refiner, Nutrient Processor, Transfer Items, fossil or Install Technology picker open, or an inventory's craft list, press the hotkey and type part of an item name to show only matching items.
desc.PickerTweaks.typed_quantity: Press the hotkey while holding a stack or on a refiner amount to type the number instead of using the arrows.
desc.PickerTweaks.search_key: The key that opens the text box for searching or typing an amount.
desc.PickerTweaks.shield: Keeps controller buttons from reaching the menu behind the text box. Turn off if the controller misbehaves.
desc.PickerTweaks.log_names: Writes each picker item's name key and the text the game shows for it to the log. Changes nothing.
desc.SmallerInventorySlots.filter_foods: Adds a Foods button to the inventory filters that lights cooking ingredients, dishes, fish and creature feed such as Creature Pellets.
desc.SmallerInventorySlots.filter_custom: Adds a Custom button: while it is selected, click items to mark them (Custom marks sets whether that marks one stack or the whole item); Quick Transfer and Deposit then move only marked items. Marks clear when you leave the Custom filter, unless Keep Custom marks is on, and always on a game restart.
desc.SmallerInventorySlots.custom_mark: What a click with the Custom filter marks. Clicked stack: only that stack lights and moves, and its mark goes when the stack leaves that slot. Every stack of the item: all stacks of that item light, in every inventory. Changing this clears the marks.
desc.SmallerInventorySlots.custom_rememb: Keeps your Custom filter marks after you pick another filter or close the menu. Off: marks clear when you leave the Custom filter.
desc.RefinerGuard.guard: Refuses to move or delete a refiner or Nutrient Processor that still holds items, because the game deletes them, and tells you to empty it first.
ui.refiner_guard_notice: Empty this refiner first: moving it deletes its contents.
